CERAMITELL 2026

CERAMITELL is a fine ceramics manufacturer focused on high-performance ceramic powders and precision ceramic components, located in Hangzhou with a production base covering about 13 acres, including more than 6,000 square meters of building area.

We specialize in the research, production, and sales of high-purity ultra-fine silicon nitride powder and advanced ceramic products. Our main product range includes silicon nitride powder, zirconia, alumina, aluminum nitride, precision ceramic balls, ceramic bearings, ceramic heating and ignition components, ceramic structural parts, ceramic cutting tools, and aluminum nitride substrates.

With automated powder production technology and cooperation with scientific research institutions, CERAMITELL provides stable product quality, technical support, and customized solutions for customers with different application requirements. We are able to manufacture standard products as well as non-standard precision ceramic parts according to drawings, samples, working conditions, or specific performance needs.

Our products are widely used in industrial machinery, aerospace, petrochemical equipment, automotive systems, electric power, textile machinery, medical equipment, wind power, high-speed rail, electronics, oilfield equipment, and other demanding industries. The materials are selected for applications requiring wear resistance, corrosion resistance, high temperature stability, electrical insulation, dimensional stability, and long service life.

CERAMITELL is committed to continuous innovation, reliable quality, and practical customer service. We aim to help customers improve equipment performance, reduce maintenance costs, and develop more durable ceramic material solutions.

 

Key Strengths

1. Focus on high-performance fine ceramic materials and components.

2. Automated powder production technology and stable manufacturing capability.

3. Product coverage from ceramic powder to precision ceramic finished parts.

4. Custom production available for drawings, samples, and special working conditions.

5. Applications across machinery, energy, automotive, electronics, medical, and high-end industrial fields.

6. Emphasis on quality consistency, technical cooperation, and long-term customer value.

 

 

 

 

 

 

Silicon Nitride Ceramic Products

1. Superfine Ceramic Powder

Silicon Nitride Powder

Silicon nitride is an important structural ceramic material. It is a hard, wear-resistant ceramic with good oxidation resistance at elevated temperatures, low thermal expansion, and strong resistance to thermal shock. Silicon nitride ceramics are widely used in bearings, turbine components, mechanical seals, permanent molds, and other precision mechanical parts.

CERAMITELL can customize silicon nitride powders for different processing routes, including sintering powder, refined powder, and formula powder according to customer requirements.

2. Precision Ceramic Balls

2.1 Silicon Nitride Ball

Silicon nitride ceramic balls are suitable for bearings and motion systems with demanding performance requirements, including high-speed and ultra-high-speed bearings, high-precision bearings, vacuum bearings, high- and low-temperature bearings, non-magnetic bearings, and precision ball screws.

They can also be used as valve balls and measuring balls in chemical pumps, high-temperature pumps, and metering pumps, and for sliding or measuring applications such as high-temperature slide rails and corrosion-resistant slide rails.

Silicon nitride balls are commonly assembled into hybrid bearings for aerospace, defense, chemical, metallurgical, medical, food, oilfield, electronics, and other industrial applications.

2.2 Zirconia Ball

Zirconia ceramic balls are used as valve balls, full ceramic bearing balls, force-measuring balls, track balls, and fine grinding balls. They are suitable for high-temperature, corrosion-resistant, insulating, and non-lubricated applications, and can replace steel balls in corrosive environments.

As valve balls, zirconia ceramic balls are used in high-pressure homogenizers, diaphragm pumps, metering pumps, oilfield pumps, high-pressure spray guns, and related equipment.

3. Ceramic Bearings

3.1 Silicon Nitride Ceramic Ball Bearings

Silicon nitride ceramic ball bearings are hybrid bearings in which the rolling elements are silicon nitride ceramic balls and the inner and outer rings are made of metal. The bearing structure is the same as conventional metal ball bearings.

Item

Specification

Ring material

Bearing steel or stainless steel

Rolling element

Silicon nitride ceramic balls

Accuracy

P0-P4

Size range

Minimum inner diameter 3 mm; maximum outer diameter 250 mm

Models

More than 3,000 metric and inch ball bearing models, including deep-groove ball bearings, self-aligning ball bearings, angular-contact ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, and insert bearings. Open, sealed, and shielded structures are available.

Cage options

Nylon, PTFE, PEEK, stainless steel, brass, or full-complement design

Customization

Non-standard bearings can be designed and produced according to customer operating conditions.

Performance Advantages

1. Higher limiting speed: silicon nitride is lighter than steel, reducing centrifugal force during operation and supporting higher limiting speeds at the same accuracy level.

2. High precision: ceramic hardness and Young's modulus are higher than steel, helping reduce mechanical deformation under the same load.

3. Longer service life: lower mass, reduced raceway load, and lower friction can help reduce operating temperature rise and wear.

4. Electrical insulation: silicon nitride balls are non-conductive and suitable for insulation applications.

5. Poor-lubrication or no-lubrication applications: silicon nitride rolling elements reduce adhesive interaction with steel and provide better performance under severe lubrication conditions.

Applications include high-speed electric spindles, machine-tool spindles, dental drill bearings, high-speed grinding heads, instrument bearings, hard disk drive bearings, roller skates, fishing reels, model aircraft, and electric toys.

3.2 Zirconia Ceramic Ball Bearings

Zirconia ceramic ball bearings are hybrid bearings in which the rolling elements are zirconia ceramic balls and the inner and outer rings are made of metal. The bearing structure is the same as conventional metal ball bearings.

More than 3,000 metric and inch ball bearing models, including deep-groove ball bearings, self-aligning ball bearings, angular-contact ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, and insert bearings. Open, sealed, and shielded structures are available.

Cage options

Nylon, PTFE, PEEK, stainless steel, brass, or full-complement design

Customization

Non-standard bearings can be designed and produced according to customer operating conditions.

Performance Advantages

1. Higher limiting speed than all-steel bearings in suitable designs due to lower ceramic rolling-element mass.

2. High precision: ceramic hardness and Young's modulus help reduce mechanical deformation under load.

3. Longer service life in suitable applications due to reduced centrifugal load, lower friction, and lower wear.

4. Electrical insulation: zirconia balls are non-conductive and suitable for insulation applications.

5. Poor-lubrication or no-lubrication applications: zirconia rolling elements can operate in demanding lubrication conditions when the bearing design is properly selected.

Applications include high-speed electric spindles, machine-tool spindles, dental drill bearings, high-speed grinding heads, instrument bearings, hard disk drive bearings, roller skates, fishing reels, model aircraft, and electric toys.

3.3 Full Silicon Nitride Ceramic Ball Bearings

Full silicon nitride ceramic bearings use silicon nitride ceramic for the inner ring, outer ring, and rolling elements.

Item

Specification

Accuracy

P0-P5

Size range

Minimum inner diameter 3 mm; maximum outer diameter 200 mm

Models

Deep-groove ball bearings, self-aligning ball bearings, angular-contact ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, and insert bearings. Open, sealed, and shielded structures are available.

Cage options

Nylon, PTFE, PEEK, stainless steel, brass, or full-complement design

Customization

Non-standard bearings can be designed and produced according to customer operating conditions.

Advantages Compared with Steel Bearings

1. High-temperature capability: full silicon nitride ceramic bearings can be used in high-temperature applications up to about 1050℃, subject to bearing structure and cage selection.

2. Corrosion resistance: suitable for acid, alkali, and salt-corrosion environments.

3. Temperature stability: lower thermal expansion than steel helps reduce clearance change under temperature fluctuations.

4. Anti-seizure performance: low thermal expansion helps reduce thermal deformation and seizure risk.

5. Oil-free operation: ceramic materials can operate in high-vacuum or difficult-lubrication environments when correctly designed.

6. Electrical insulation and antistatic applications: ceramic bearings are non-conductive and help avoid electrical pitting common in steel bearings.

7. Magnetic environments: ceramic materials are non-magnetic, reducing adhesion of magnetic particles in raceways.

Applications include chemical processing, fluid systems, smelting, food processing, electronics, semiconductors, medical equipment, vacuum systems, insulation applications, and non-magnetic environments.

Applications include chemical processing, fluid systems, smelting, food processing, electronics, semiconductors, medical equipment, vacuum systems, insulation applications, and non-magnetic environments.

4. Silicon Nitride Ceramic Hot Surface Igniters

4.1 Hot Surface Igniters

Hot surface ignition is safe, quiet, reliable, and free from electromagnetic interference. After the igniter is energized and reaches ignition temperature, the combustible mixture is introduced. This ignition method helps reduce gas leakage and deflagration risks associated with poorly timed conventional ignition.

High-power hot surface ignition adapts to changes in gas type, composition, air-fuel ratio, temperature, humidity, and oil contamination. The system operates quietly and reduces interference with surrounding electrical appliances.

Features of Hot Surface Igniter

Silicon nitride ceramic hot surface igniters are an advanced application of hot surface ignition technology. Compared with metal heating wires, silicon nitride ceramic heating elements provide higher operating temperature capability and longer service life. Compared with conventional silicon carbide heating elements, silicon nitride offers a denser and stronger structure with better resistance to moisture and mechanical damage.

CERAMITELL silicon nitride hot surface igniters are available across a wide product range, with working voltages from 4 V to 240 V and power ratings from 10 W to 300 W. They can be used for ignition and heating in gas and fuel-oil equipment.

· Lead wires: 200°C, 250°C, 450°C, and 550°C wire options, common sizes include 16, 18, and 20 AWG.

· Ceramic mounting seat: commonly 95% alumina ceramic. In addition to standard square 95% alumina ceramic mounting seats, customized shapes and materials are available.

· Mounting flange: commonly 304 stainless steel, brass and other customized materials are available.

5. Silicon Nitride Ceramic Heaters

5.1 Silicon Nitride Heaters

Liquid-heating silicon nitride ceramic electric heating elements provide high power density and are mainly used in liquid- and water-heating equipment, solar water heaters, and instant water heaters.

· Lead wires: 200°C, 250°C, 450°C, and 550°C wire options; common sizes include 16, 18, and 20 AWG.

· Installation: standard designs use silicone sealing rings, special shapes and materials can be customized.

· Mounting flange: commonly 304 stainless steel, customized materials and structures are available.

5.2 Silicon Nitride Ceramic Photovoltaic Soldering Knife

BLK-SN2 and BLK-SN3 series silicon nitride ceramic photovoltaic soldering knives are used for soldering solar photovoltaic panels. They offer acid and alkali resistance, corrosion resistance, uniform tin-point formation, precise soldering depth, convenient replacement, and long service life.

· Lead wires: 200°C, 250°C, 450°C, and 550°C wire options, common sizes include 16, 18, and 20 AWG mica fiberglass wire.

· Ceramic mounting seat: commonly 95% alumina ceramic. In addition to standard square 95% alumina ceramic mounting seats, customized shapes and materials are available.

· Mounting flange: commonly 304 stainless steel, brass and other customized materials are available.

6. Ceramic Structural Parts

6.1 Silicon Nitride Ceramic Lift Tube

The silicon nitride ceramic lift tube is an electric heating system specially designed for liquid aluminum. It can be inserted directly into molten metal, transferring heat energy directly to the metal liquid.

It offers thermal-shock resistance, good mechanical properties, good thermal conductivity, and corrosion resistance. The protective sleeve is filled with materials with high thermal conductivity and high insulation resistance, supporting high power-density electric heating.

 

6.2 Silicon Nitride Ceramic Turbine

Silicon nitride ceramic turbines provide temperature resistance, wear resistance, long service life, energy saving, and reduced consumption. Silicon nitride ceramic turbine technology has been recognized in national key scientific and technological projects, and related silicon nitride ceramic products include turbines, inserts, cylinder liners, rocker arms, tappets, and valves for automotive engines.

High-performance silicon nitride ceramics provide high-temperature mechanical strength, wear resistance, acid and alkali corrosion resistance, hot hardness, and self-lubricating behavior. They are suitable for aerospace, petroleum, chemical, electrical, mechanical, machining, and other engineering applications requiring high temperature, corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and high strength.

 

6.3 Silicon Nitride Ceramic Shaft Rod

Silicon nitride ceramic shaft rods can be used for grinding high-purity minerals and for high-temperature rolling and conveying of metallurgical minerals.

 

6.4 Silicon Nitride High-Speed Cutting Blade

Silicon nitride high-speed cutting blades are used for high-speed cutting of lithium battery films, cigarette tin foil, and other thin materials.

Performance features include fast cutting speed, clean cutting without damaging the material, high-temperature resistance, long service life, high hardness, wear resistance, good chemical stability, and a low friction coefficient. These blades are suitable for micron-level lithium battery film cutting and other precision thin-film cutting applications.

Ultra-thin silicon nitride ceramic high-speed lithium battery film cutting blades are available.
